Why virtual tours work in central Bangalore

MG Road, Brigade Road, Church Street and the streets around UB City draw shoppers, visitors and office workers from across the city. With so many stores, pubs and restaurants side by side, people rely on Google Maps to decide where to go.

A 360° tour lets them see the store floor, the bar or the dining room before they arrive — and helps visitors find an entrance tucked into a busy street or up a flight of stairs.

Capturing high-footfall spaces

Central locations are busiest in the evenings and at weekends, so capture happens early in the day with displays set and lights on. Hotels and offices are planned around guests and working hours.

Frequently asked questions — MG Road & Brigade Road

Do you shoot 360° virtual tours in MG Road & Brigade Road?

Yes. Thamco360’s scan crew travels to businesses and properties across Bangalore, including MG Road & Brigade Road, and deploys within 48 hours of booking. There is no studio to visit — the crew comes to you.

Can a tour help customers find a first-floor store or pub on Brigade Road?

Yes. Panoramas of the approach and entrance can be included, so visitors recognise the building and the right staircase or lift when they arrive.

When do you shoot a busy pub or store in central Bangalore?

Early in the day, before opening, with the space set up as it is for customers. That gives a clear, accurate tour with no crowds in frame.
